stem: What was one result of the Treaty of Paris of 1783?

options.label: F
options.text: Great Britain recognized the United States as an independent country.

options.label: G
options.text: Competing Seminole and Spanish claims in West Florida were resolved.

options.label: H
options.text: The British navy agreed to stop pressing American sailors into service.

options.label: J
options.text: British territory in eastern Canada was ceded to France.
